---
title: Hand Gestures
---

Inspect built-in heuristic hand gestures. Events update the inspector and write
details to the browser console. Compare pose changes, recognized names, and
tracking loss rather than treating a drawn hand as evidence of recognition.

Use the simulator's pose tools or tracked hands on a supported device.

[Hands and gestures](/sdk/gestures) · [Simulator controls](/sdk/simulator) · [Example catalog](/examples)
